ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely high ratio of high-intensity white pixels (covering ~95% of visible surface) to low-intensity black pixels localized on the trailing edge and tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant solid high-intensity white field across medial and central fluke regions. Black contiguous banding along the entire trailing edge. High-density black clusters at the extreme distal tips (corners).

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an approximate pixel angle of 65 degrees; vertical depth is approximately 1/8th of the total visible fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations distributed across the trailing boundary. Serration density increases toward the distal tips, showing irregular peak heights ranging from 2-10 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edges exhibit a concave curve toward the median notch and a convex sweep toward the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized high-contrast dark pixel clusters at the far-left and far-right trailing edge corners, indicating textured surface irregularities.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Minor irregular indentation/notching on the trailing edge of the left lobe, approximately midway between the notch and the lateral tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Exceptional uniformity of high-intensity white pigmentation across the ventral surface, lacking common mottling or speckling found in similar specimens.
